name: Lightning Tv Expert Plugin
description: Lightning TV framework expertise for @lightningtv/solid Smart TV applications. Auto-triggers on @lightningtv/solid imports. Provides guardrails against DOM hallucination and a traversable knowledge graph of 80 atomic API/rule reference notes.
longDescription:
Ships **1 skill**, `lightning-tv` (Lightning TV framework expertise for @lightningtv/solid v3.x Smart TV applications).

Installs with `claude plugin install lightning-tv-expert-plugin@claude-community` from `rwaltenberg/lightning-tv-solid-plugin`.

A Claude Code plugin that provides framework expertise for building Smart TV applications with `@lightningtv/solid` v3.x.
